title: console copy: the runtime console's 「此环境 / 本环境」 strings name the system the user is already in, not a cloud noun (cloud#3002 ruling A, inventory group 三)
body:
Filed by the director seat (summon #43 continuation 5, `session_01QJC7i981TSs9L1CGJK59Ax`) from objectstack-ai/cloud#3002, ruled A by the maintainer on 2026-10-18 (batch #364 item 2): keep the two nouns 组织 / 环境 and keep 「环境」 out of a single-production user's way. The inventory on that card (6247161029, group 三) found about 20 zh-CN strings in the objectui runtime console that say 「此环境 / 本环境」 to a user who is already inside the system. They are platform copy shown by every ObjectStack deployment, so under the maintainer's 口径 「平台相关的功能，应该尽量先改平台」 they are this card, not cloud's. ⛔ Not a claim.

## Scope (`packages/i18n/src/locales/zh.ts`; line numbers from the inventory at cloud's pin `c4dd7078`)
- `console/settingsHub` (「配置环境、集成与功能开关」, 「Workspace: 环境」), `workspaceTimezonePrompt` (「设置环境时区」), `readRate` (「本环境读取量异常」), `auth/*` (「本环境未开放自助注册」, 「您正在登录此环境」), `profile/password` (「在此环境登录所用的密码」), `home/*` (「正在加载环境…」, 「配置您的环境」), `connectAgent` (「本环境的 MCP 端点」), `aiModelStatus`.
- Rule: inside the running system, 「此环境 / 本环境」 → 「本系统」, or omitted where the sentence reads without it. The English source strings change only where they say "this environment" to the same user ("this system" / omit); the other locales follow the same rule.
- ⛔ Not in scope: `settingsView` 「环境变量锁定」 (`zh.ts:1809`–`:1826`, environment variables — another sense of the word); the cloud control plane (cloud#3002's own scope); the onboarding strings that explain the noun once (`cloudOnboarding.*`, kept).

## Acceptance
- Each string above re-reads without 「环境」 as a cloud noun; locale tests and generated baselines pass; no key renamed.
- Changeset: patch on `@object-ui/i18n`.
